# Unlinked Typography & Font Suites

This directory contains the custom typography suites for **Unlinked External** and the **Unlinked UI Framework**.

---

## Supported Typography Families

### 1. Inter (Modern Sleek UI Standard)
- `Inter-Regular.ttf`
- `Inter-Medium.ttf`
- `Inter-SemiBold.ttf`

### 2. JetBrains Mono (Developer & Code Display)
- `JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf`
- `JetBrainsMono-Medium.ttf`
- `JetBrainsMono-SemiBold.ttf`

### 3. Outfit (Geometric Modern Display)
- `Outfit-Regular.ttf`
- `Outfit-Medium.ttf`
- `Outfit-SemiBold.ttf`

### 4. Montserrat (Sleek Clean Display)
- `Montserrat-Regular.ttf`
- `Montserrat-Medium.ttf`
- `Montserrat-SemiBold.ttf`
